minutes.headline: EDC agreed to meet Town Manager and land use director in a small group first, not a business forum, aiming for a fall bylaw.
minutes.summary: The Economic Development Committee met by Zoom, approved the January minutes, and discussed how to run a business forum on permitting hurdles. Members concluded a small initial meeting with the land use director, possibly the building commissioner, would be quicker and less awkward for businesses than a public forum. The chair also gave a long update on vacant storefronts and new businesses, then adjourned.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none was offered by residents.

decisions.decision: Chair will email the town's land use director and Town Manager that evening asking to hold the business forum at the library.
Members favored a first small meeting with the land use director and ideally the building commissioner before any forum with businesses.
Chair will try to schedule that small meeting for a later afternoon, with about a week's notice for Josie, and will check whether it would count as a meeting under open meeting law.
Chair will ask Logan about IT training and tools available to the committee, and about earlier business survey results.
Next meeting set for the last Thursday of April; chair will email everyone after speaking with the land use director and Town Manager.
